title: Non-dense fitting B: every E8 term with x·y ≠ 0 has rank ≥ 9; square root-code floors E8 ≥ 72, P112 ≥ 64, P104 ≥ 56, D4 ≥ 12 for any fitting B (no κ claim)
body:
## What this adds
Only `research/nondense-pairing-square-floors/`. Extends the dense-pairing floor of `research/ideal-decoder-floors/` (Theorem 4) to **any fitting B** (B_tt = 1, B_ts = 0 on non-orthogonal pairs, free on orthogonal pairs) for *square* root-code decoders (m = T, XYᵀ = I). Related: #968, #1744 (rank ≥ 9 on P111/P112 in its scope), #2176, #2338 (Theorems P, R).

- **Lemmas 6.1-6.3 (PROVEN, written proofs):** per-term fitting minrank = mr₂ of the orthogonality graph on R∩A; normal-pair reduction; orthogonal-set deletion lowers mr₂ by ≤ 1.
- **Theorem 6 (CHECKED):** all 4022 non-orthogonal root-hyperplane pair types of E8 (440 880 hyperplanes, `W_J = Stab(n₁)`-orbits, min |D| = 30) are UNSAT at fitting rank ≤ 8, each with a drat-trim VERIFIED proof; two independent orbit implementations and two independent CNF writers; brute force over all fitting B agrees with both writers on 60 instances.
- **Corollary 6.4:** square root-code decoders cost ≥ 72 (E8), ≥ 64 (P112), ≥ 56 (P104), ≥ 12 (D4) for any fitting B, all sharp (exact decoders re-built and checked).
- **Counterexamples to the per-term claim (CHECKED):** E8 orthogonal normals |D| = 24, mr₂ = 6; D6 non-orthogonal types with mr₂ 3-4 (scan |D| ≤ 19 only); one E7 type |D| = 11, mr₂ = 5. No decoder below any floor is shown (B is shared across terms).
- **Open / not claimed:** overcomplete decoders with x_j ⊥ y_j terms, E7/D6 square (global-B coupling), factors outside the root code. No κ claim.

## Verification
`bash verify.sh` (a few minutes, ≤ 2 processes): manifest, vendored drat-trim build, both orbit recounts and their agreement, fixed 32-type sample re-solved by both writers with DRAT VERIFIED, brute-force agreement, the counterexamples, the sharp decoders. `FULL=1 bash verify.sh` re-solves all 4022 types with both writers, every proof drat-trim VERIFIED; it was run in full at this head and passes (log in `evidence/verify_FULL.log`). `PROOF_MAP.md` lists claim → check; anything unchecked is CONDITIONAL in the README.
